info.title: BrandMuse API
info.description: FastAPI Backend for BrandMuse - AI Brand Assistant for Creative Teams

get.description: Returns current server status, active provider names, and database connectivity.

post.description: Streams and validates a guideline PDF (max 10MB, max 40 pages), then indexes it.

get.description: Returns guidelines uploaded by the current session plus the shared sample brand.

post.description: Loads the preloaded sample brand guideline ('Aura Living') for demo interaction.
Streams token-by-token answer via Server-Sent Events (SSE) grounded in retrieved brand guidelines, concluding with citations (page + snippet) and Langfuse trace link.
Generate 3 distinct creative concepts grounded strictly in uploaded brand guidelines.

post.summary: Iteratively refine a single campaign concept based on creative feedback
post.description: Refine a single campaign concept incorporating user feedback while enforcing brand rules.

post.summary: Generate Stable Diffusion visual asset for a campaign concept
post.description: Generate image with safety moderation, rate limits, and Cloudflare R2 persistence.

get.summary: Retrieve all generated assets for the active user session
get.description: List all images generated within the current isolated session ordered newest first.

post.description: Analyzes the document's indexed text chunks to extract brand identity, colors, typography, and DOs/DONTs.

get.description: Retrieves the structured ontology and certified brand rules.

put.description: Allows brand managers to edit and refine colors, typography, and rules.

post.description: Marks the extracted brand rules as certified and verified by a brand manager.
